items.title: 水泥雙雄10月營收 台泥163.57億元創22個月新高、亞泥雙減
items.title_en: Cement Twins October Revenue: Taiwan Cement Posts NT$16.357 B 22‑Month High, Asia Cement Declines
paras: 水泥雙雄公布10月營收，台泥(1101-TW)10月營收163.57億元，創2025年1月以來近22個月新高，月增14.2%、年增17.83%；不過，亞泥(1102-TW)10月營收54.31億元，月減19%、年減6.9%，呈現不同調。累計前10月，台泥營收1,294.05億元，年增4.93%；亞泥累計營收則為558.45億元，年減5.3%。
台泥表示，10月營收成長主要來自能源及儲能業務，水泥事業亦受惠中國大陸市場量價回升，以及葡萄牙水泥市場穩健成長，營收較去年同期增加。其中，能源事業單月及累計營收均較去年成長，NHOA受惠旗下NHOA Energy儲能工程(EPC)案件量增加，成為10月主要成長動能之一；台泥循環鋰電池出貨量也增加，帶動營收成長。
兩岸水泥事業方面，台泥表示，10月營收較去年同期增加6.29億元，累計前10月增加26.11億元。雖然中國大陸市場整體需求仍偏緩，但受惠十一假期後需求增加、價格回升，銷量較去年同期增加；台灣市場則受房貸限貸措施、房市政策及進口低價水泥競爭影響，需求仍偏緩。
亞泥表示，10月營收較去年同期減少，主要受到兩岸水泥銷售表現及台灣預拌混凝土業務變化影響。台灣市場方面，水泥及預拌混凝土銷量下降，加上電力收入減少，市場營收年減9%；大陸市場則因水泥售價年增3%，部分抵銷銷量年減14%的影響，市場營收年減3%。
若與9月相比，亞泥台灣市場營收月減27%，主要受到預拌混凝土量價同步下滑，以及轉投資收入減少影響；大陸市場方面，雖水泥銷量減少6%，但售價進一步上漲7%，帶動營收月增1%，顯示價格回升對營收具有一定支撐。亞泥表示，營運仍受到兩岸市場需求及價格變化影響，將持續透過多元事業布局及營運管理，穩健推動各項業務發展。
paras_en: The two cement giants released their October revenues: Taiwan Cement (1101‑TW) posted NT$163.57 billion for the month, a 22‑month high since January 2025, up 14.2% month‑over‑month and 17.83% year‑over‑year; Asia Cement (1102‑TW) reported NT$54.31 billion, down 19% month‑over‑month and 6.9% year‑over‑year, showing a divergent trend. For the first ten months of the year, Taiwan Cement’s cumulative revenue reached NT$1,294.05 billion, a 4.93% increase year‑over‑year, while Asia Cement’s cumulative revenue was NT$558.45 billion, a 5.3% decline year‑over‑year.

Taiwan Cement said the October revenue growth came mainly from its energy and energy‑storage businesses, while its cement segment also benefited from a rebound in volume and price in the mainland China market and steady growth in Portugal’s cement market, resulting in higher revenue compared with the same period last year. In the energy segment, both monthly and cumulative revenues rose year‑over‑year; NHOA gained from an increase in NHOA Energy storage‑project (EPC) orders, becoming one of the main growth drivers in October, and Taiwan Cement’s shipments of recycled lithium‑ion batteries also rose, contributing to revenue growth.

Regarding the cross‑strait cement business, Taiwan Cement noted that October revenue was NT$6.29 billion higher than the same month last year, and cumulative revenue for the first ten months was NT$26.11 billion higher. Although overall demand in mainland China remains sluggish, the post‑National‑Day holiday boost in demand and price recovery lifted sales versus last year; in Taiwan, demand stayed weak due to mortgage‑lending restrictions, housing‑market policies and competition from low‑priced imported cement.

Asia Cement said its October revenue fell versus the same month last year, mainly due to the performance of cement sales on both sides of the strait and changes in its Taiwan ready‑mix concrete business. In Taiwan, cement and ready‑mix concrete volumes declined, and lower electricity income reduced market revenue by 9% year‑over‑year; in the mainland market, cement prices rose 3% year‑over‑year, partially offsetting a 14% drop in volume, resulting in a 3% year‑over‑year decline in market revenue.

Compared with September, Asia Cement’s Taiwan‑market revenue dropped 27% month‑over‑month, driven by simultaneous declines in ready‑mix concrete volume and price as well as reduced investment‑income; in the mainland market, cement volume fell 6% but prices rose an additional 7%, lifting revenue by 1% month‑over‑month, indicating that price recovery provides some support. Asia Cement said its operations remain affected by demand and price shifts across the two markets, and it will continue to pursue steady business development through diversified business布局 and operational management.

items.title: Anthropic招股意外泄露融資細節！台積電等7大科技巨頭傳砸260億美元投資、估值遭下修
paras: 人工智慧（AI）新創公司Anthropic的首次公開募股（IPO）進程出現插曲。《路透》報導指出，Anthropic日前向承銷銀行發送一份包含股票發行數量及定價區間的招股文件，卻隨後發出更正通知，坦承文件中的定價資訊有誤，並表示將另行提供更新版本。此外，潛在投資者對Anthropic的估值預期大幅下調，上市時機與定價合理性同時受到質疑。
根據《路透》取得的週一（9日）電子郵件，Anthropic最初提供的文件顯示，公司計畫以每股70至80美元發行約8.67億股A類普通股，預計募資最高可達693億美元。
此外，輝達(NVDA-US) 、超微半導體(AMD-US) 、博通(AVGO-US) 、美光科技(MU-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 及台積電(2330-TW) 等科技巨頭，據稱將以IPO發行價合計投入260億美元，參與私募配售。
不過，Anthropic隨後寄出的第二封郵件明確指出，先前文件中的定價細節有誤，公司將在稍後更新招股文件。
與此同時，Anthropic的IPO計畫正面臨嚴峻考驗。在科技股遭遇重挫、那斯達克100指數單日暴跌6.4%之後，潛在投資者對這家A​​I公司的估值預期大幅下調，上市時機與定價合理性同時受到質疑。
知情人士透露，部分潛在投資者目前討論的估值區間已降至1.2兆至1.3兆美元。

IPO規模上看數百億美元 七大科技巨頭傳參與投資

Anthropic最初發送給銀行人士的文件，不僅揭露預計發行股數及價格區間，也列出大型科技企業參與私募配售的安排。
按照原始文件內容，公司計畫發行約8.67億股A類普通股，若以每股70至80美元計算，募資金額最高可達693億美元。
參與私募配售的七家科技巨頭，則涵蓋AI晶片設計、半導體製造及雲端運算等產業環節，顯示這宗IPO可能牽動整個AI供應鏈。
此外，文件也顯示，基石投資者預計在此次IPO中出售約2,333萬股既有股份。這部分屬於老股轉讓，資金將流向出售股份的投資者，而非Anthropic本身。因此，此次上市計畫同時涉及公司新股發行及既有股東出售持股。
不過，Anthropic隨即撤回先前披露的定價資訊，市場目前仍須等待經修正的正式文件，才能確認實際發行規模及相關條件。

傳最快11月10日啟動路演 目標下周四、五掛牌

儘管招股文件出現錯誤，Anthropic的上市時程仍已進入關鍵階段。
根據《彭博》報導，Anthropic於10月26日公開提交招股書後，依照相關規定，最快可於11月10日啟動正式IPO路演。公司目標是在11月16日當周完成定價，並趕在11月26日美國感恩節假期前於那斯達克掛牌，預計股票代號為「ANT」。
不過，近期市場波動也使Anthropic的估值面臨調整壓力。數月前，市場曾討論公司估值可能達到2兆美元，但這項預期如今已明顯降溫。
《彭博》6日引述知情人士報導，部分潛在投資者討論的估值已降至約1.2兆至1.3兆美元，甚至有人考慮將估值下修至1.1兆美元。
此前，投資人在10月公司財務簡報後向承銷銀行給出的估值為1.4兆至1.5兆美元，而今年10月初的預期高峰一度高達2兆美元。上述知情人士表示，相關討論仍在進行中，尚未形成最終決定。 Anthropic發言人拒絕置評。
報導指出，Anthropic本周已安排與關鍵投資者會面，目標是讓股票於下周四或周五開始交易。不過，公司仍可能延後估值目標，等待更有利的市場環境，但此舉也可能引發市場恐慌。

items.title: 〈電信三雄財報〉台灣大前10月獲利144.5億元超越去年 EPS 4.74元續坐獲利王寶座
items.title_en: <Telecom Trio Earnings> Taiwan Mobile Leads with NT$14.45 B Profit in First 10 Months, EPS NT$4.74 Retains Profit King Crown
paras: 電信三雄今(10)日公告10月財務數字，台灣大(3045-TW)再度成為獲利王，累計今年前10月稅後純益達144.5億元，超越2025年全年獲利，每股純益達4.74元，高於中華電信(2412-TW)的4.71元，以及遠傳(4904-TW)的3.5元。

中華電信 

中華電信10月營收237.5億元，月減2.66%，年增13.47%；EBITDA 81億元，月減7.32%，年增7.86%；稅後純益35.9億元，月減19.14%，年增13.97%，每股純益0.46元。
中華電信累計今年前10月營收2126.9億元，年增11.12%；EBITDA 805.8億元，年增7.83%；稅後純益365.6億元，年增12.29%，每股純益4.71元。
中華電信指出，10月營收與EBITDA創歷年同期高，其中，營收成長受惠手機銷售延續9月動能，電信核心業務穩健成長，以及資通訊業務強勁攀升。此外，子公司也受惠AI需求持續成長，產品出貨動能提升，大幅挹注銷貨收入。
行動服務方面，受惠iPhone新機銷售熱絡帶動5G升速方案持續熱銷，高資費用戶穩健成長，加上月租型客戶數持續年增，帶動行動服務營收年增3.6%，月租型ARPU也年增2.8%至578元。固網寬頻業務則受惠AI與數位應用持續推升高速頻寬需求，10月300Mbps以上高速寬頻用戶數年增14.6%，帶動固網寬頻營收年增3.0%，國內電路出租營收同步躍升。
資通訊業務部分，10月營收年增39.9%，為營收成長的主要引擎。主要受惠大型IDC機房建置完工認列、電網儲能系統專案交付，以及海外子公司台商建廠專案完工挹注，帶動IDC及雲端、智慧聯網等相關營收皆年增5成以上。
中華電信持續深化AI布局與創新應用，10月子公司「中華曜智科技股份有限公司」正式成立，整合AI影像辨識、智慧安防及邊緣運算技術，聚焦企業安防、公共安全、智慧城市及創新影像應用，將AI技術實力轉化為智慧解決方案與成長動能。
在數位內容方面，中華電信深化影視內容投資布局，攜手中華數位文創公布多項投資計畫。透過多元投資、跨國共製及國際合作，推動台灣原創IP從內容開發、製作到海外市場拓展，擴大優質內容版圖與IP價值。

台灣大 

台灣大10月營收170.7億元，月減1.95%，年增9.28%；EBITDA 38.98億元，月增4.45%，年增14.31%；稅後純益15億元，月增2.04%，年增31.58%，每股純益0.48元。
台灣大累計今年前10月營收1666.4億元，年增5.74%；EBITDA 380.63億元，年增8.19%；稅後純益144.5億元，年增23.72%，每股純益4.74元。
Telco電信本業方面，新一代iPhone新機換機需求延續，推升單月銷貨收入年增雙位數；家用寬頻事業穩定成長，帶動家戶事業營收年增16%。
Telco+企業事業上，AIDC穩定貢獻營收，加上10月認列企業資通訊專案收入，挹注企業服務營收成長；Telco+Tech新科技事業部分，遊戲代理事業單月營收年增8%，品牌電商持續擴張，旗下代理品牌3COINS第二家實體店正式開幕，進一步擴大營運動能。
遠傳累計今年前10月營收978.48億元，年增10.33%；EBITDA 337.73億元，年增7.15%；稅後純益126.13億元，年增11.35%，每股純益3.5元。
遠傳指出，受惠iPhone新機上市帶動用戶升級5G、手機銷售表現優於去年同期，以及企業智慧資通訊業務穩健成長，10月營收創歷史單月新高。
行動通訊業務方面，遠傳10月總用戶數成長，月租型用戶流失率維持低檔。iPhone換機潮帶動5G升級，10月月租型用戶5G滲透率達到50.4%。月租型用戶每月平均貢獻度(ARPU)連續22個月年增，帶動行動服務營收達53.37億元
企業智慧資通訊業務延續成長動能，受惠雲端專案順利交付，營收維持雙位數成長；資安、智慧城市及物聯網等業務也同步成長，企業數位轉型需求持續發酵。
paras_en: The three major telecom operators announced their October financial figures today (the 10th). Taiwan Mobile (3045‑TW) again topped the profit chart, with cumulative net profit after tax of NT$14.45 billion for the first ten months of the year, surpassing its full‑year 2025 profit. Earnings per share reached NT$4.74, higher than Chunghwa Telecom (2412‑TW) at NT$4.71 and Far EasTone (4904‑TW) at NT$3.5.

Chunghwa Telecom: October revenue was NT$23.75 billion, down 2.66% month‑on‑month but up 13.47% year‑on‑year; EBITDA was NT$8.1 billion, down 7.32% month‑on‑month and up 7.86% year‑on‑year; net profit after tax was NT$3.59 billion, down 19.14% month‑on‑month and up 13.97% year‑on‑year, yielding earnings per share of NT$0.46.

For the first ten months, Chunghwa Telecom’s cumulative revenue reached NT$212.69 billion, up 11.12% year‑on‑year; EBITDA was NT$80.58 billion, up 7.83%; net profit after tax was NT$36.56 billion, up 12.29%, translating to earnings per share of NT$4.71.

Chunghwa Telecom noted that October revenue and EBITDA hit record highs for the same month in history. Revenue growth was driven by continued momentum in mobile phone sales from September, solid growth in core telecom services, and a strong rise in ICT services. In addition, subsidiaries benefited from sustained AI demand, boosting product shipments and significantly contributing to sales revenue.

In mobile services, robust iPhone sales spurred continued strong demand for 5G acceleration plans, while high‑value customers grew steadily. The number of postpaid customers kept increasing year‑on‑year, lifting mobile service revenue by 3.6% and raising postpaid ARPU by 2.8% to NT$578. Fixed‑line broadband benefited from AI and digital applications that drove higher demand for high‑speed bandwidth; users of 300 Mbps or faster broadband grew 14.6% year‑on‑year in October, pushing fixed‑line broadband revenue up 3.0% and boosting domestic circuit‑leasing revenue as well.

In the ICT segment, October revenue jumped 39.9% year‑on‑year, becoming the main engine of overall revenue growth. The surge was mainly due to the completion and recognition of large IDC data‑center projects, delivery of power‑grid energy‑storage system projects, and the completion of overseas subsidiary factory projects by Taiwanese investors, which lifted IDC, cloud, smart‑networking and related revenues by more than 50% each.

Chunghwa Telecom continues to deepen its AI footprint and innovative applications. In October, its subsidiary Chunghwa Yaozhi Technology Co., Ltd. was formally established, integrating AI image recognition, smart security and edge‑computing technologies. The unit focuses on enterprise security, public safety, smart cities and innovative imaging applications, turning AI expertise into intelligent solutions and growth momentum.

Regarding digital content, Chunghwa Telecom expanded its investment in film and television assets, partnering with Chunghwa Digital Cultural Creation to announce multiple investment projects. Through diversified investment, cross‑border co‑production and international collaboration, the company aims to promote Taiwanese original IP from development and production to overseas market expansion, enlarging the footprint and value of high‑quality content and IP.

Taiwan Mobile: October revenue was NT$17.07 billion, down 1.95% month‑on‑month but up 9.28% year‑on‑year; EBITDA was NT$3.898 billion, up 4.45% month‑on‑month and 14.31% year‑on‑year; net profit after tax was NT$1.5 billion, up 2.04% month‑on‑month and 31.58% year‑on‑year, yielding earnings per share of NT$0.48.

For the first ten months, Taiwan Mobile’s cumulative revenue reached NT$166.64 billion, up 5.74% year‑on‑year; EBITDA was NT$38.063 billion, up 8.19%; net profit after tax was NT$14.45 billion, up 23.72%, resulting in earnings per share of NT$4.74.

In its core telecom business, demand for the new generation iPhone continued to drive double‑digit year‑on‑year growth in monthly sales revenue. The residential broadband segment grew steadily, contributing to a 16% year‑on‑year increase in household‑business revenue.

In the Telco+ enterprise segment, AIDC consistently contributed to revenue, and October saw the recognition of enterprise ICT project income, bolstering enterprise service revenue growth. In the Telco+Tech new‑technology segment, game‑agency revenue rose 8% month‑on‑month, brand e‑commerce kept expanding, and the second physical store of its agency brand 3COINS opened, further enhancing operational momentum.

Far EasTone: October revenue was NT$11.618 billion, up 5.98% month‑on‑month and 5.31% year‑on‑year; EBITDA was NT$3.454 billion, up 1.71% month‑on‑month and 5.89% year‑on‑year; net profit after tax was NT$1.221 billion, down 5.5% month‑on‑month and 3.63% year‑on‑year, yielding earnings per share of NT$0.34.

For the first ten months, Far EasTone’s cumulative revenue reached NT$97.848 billion, up 10.33% year‑on‑year; EBITDA was NT$33.773 billion, up 7.15%; net profit after tax was NT$12.613 billion, up 11.35%, giving earnings per share of NT$3.5.

Far EasTone noted that the launch of the new iPhone boosted user upgrades to 5G, phone sales outperformed the same period last year, and enterprise smart‑ICT business grew steadily, leading to a record‑high single‑month revenue in October.

In mobile communications, Far EasTone’s total subscriber base grew in October, with postpaid churn remaining low. The iPhone upgrade wave drove 5G upgrades, pushing the postpaid 5G penetration rate to 50.4% in October. Postpaid ARPU increased year‑on‑year for 22 consecutive months, lifting mobile service revenue to NT$5.337 billion.

Enterprise smart‑ICT business maintained its growth momentum, benefiting from smooth delivery of cloud projects and achieving double‑digit revenue growth; cybersecurity, smart‑city and IoT businesses also expanded, as corporate digital‑transformation demand continued to ferment.

items.title: 黃仁勳共諜小三是人妻 丈夫康偉長相曝光！
items.title_en: Jensen Huang’s Secret Lover Is a Married Woman; Husband Kang Wei’s Face Revealed!
paras: 人工智慧（AI）晶片大廠輝達（Nvidia）(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳出軌震撼全球，據《財新網》10日（周二）報導，多位知情人士透露，共諜小三黃樂與康偉是夫妻關係，但二人近年來關係走向鮮有人知。
據《金融時報》報導，至少在2025年初，兩人還在共同為項目推介出席共同場合。
《財新網》則稱，有說法稱，康偉因操縱上市股票而牽涉刑事調查；知情人士說，康偉大約在2026年春節前已被上海警方採取刑事強制措施。
據《響亮新聞》報導，康偉出生於1975年1月，畢業於上海交通大學，32歲即擔任共同基金公司中海基金總經理，當時被業界譽為「最年輕基金公司總經理」。
據《響亮新聞》了解，黃樂目前人在中國。
黃樂，英文名Alice Huang，湖南常德人，今年約42歲。有消息稱，黃樂在北京就讀某大學期間就擁有北京市朝陽區CBD核心地帶房產。
私募機構上海和熙投資管理有限公司曾在官方賬號上揭露過黃樂的履歷。黃樂擁有4年媒體從業經歷，先後擔任湖南衛視、中央電視台一套新聞記者。
黃樂在湖南衛視的經歷，其實關係隸屬於湖南衛視合作夥伴北京遠景東方影視傳播有限公司。她在央視的經歷，她曾先後在央視財經頻道、新聞頻道實習過。
2006年前後，黃樂在香港浸會大學傳理學院就讀碩士研究生，專業是媒體管理（MA in Media Management）。
此後，黃樂進入金融行業，2008年至2012年任職於匯豐銀行私人銀行業務部門，2013年至2015年為中信證券效力。
2015年，黃樂加盟上海和熙投資管理有限公司，曾任和熙投資副總經理、執行董事、投決會委員，後來還擔任過合夥人、總經理。
paras_en: AI chip giant Nvidia (NVDA‑US) CEO Jensen Huang’s affair has shocked the world. According to Caixin on Tuesday the 10th, multiple insiders said the alleged conspiratorial mistress, Huang Le, is married to Kang Wei, though the couple’s relationship has remained largely hidden in recent years.
The Financial Times reported that as recently as early 2025 the two were still appearing together at joint events to promote projects.

Caixin added that there are claims Kang Wei is under criminal investigation for stock manipulation, and insiders said he was placed under criminal coercive measures by Shanghai police around the Spring Festival of 2026.

According to Bright News, Kang Wei was born in January 1975, graduated from Shanghai Jiao‑Tong University, and at age 32 became general manager of the mutual‑fund firm China Sea Fund, then hailed by the industry as the “youngest fund‑company general manager.”
Bright News also reports that Huang Le is currently in China.

Huang Le, whose English name is Alice Huang, is from Changde, Hunan, and is about 42 years old. It is said she owned property in the core CBD area of Chaoyang District, Beijing, while studying at a university there.

The private‑equity firm Shanghai Hexi Investment Management Co. Ltd. has previously disclosed Huang Le’s résumé on its official account. She has four years of media experience, having worked as a reporter for Hunan TV and China Central Television’s Channel 1 news.
Her stint at Hunan TV was actually through its partner Beijing Vision East Film & Media Co., and her experience at CCTV includes internships at the CCTV Finance Channel and the News Channel.
Around 2006, Huang Le pursued a master’s degree in Media Management at the School of Communication at Hong Kong Baptist University.
Afterwards she entered finance, working in HSBC’s private banking division from 2008 to 2012 and then at CITIC Securities from 2013 to 2015.
In 2015 she joined Shanghai Hexi Investment Management, serving as deputy general manager, executive director, investment‑decision committee member, and later as partner and general manager.

items.title: 統新前3Q EPS為5.02元較去年虧轉盈 新產線於2027年Q1起陸續量產
items.title_en: Tong Hsin's FYQ3 EPS at NT$5.02, Turning Profit from Last Year's Loss; New Production Lines to Commence Serial Production Starting Q1 2027
paras: 光通訊濾鏡廠統新(6426-TW)今(10)日自結第3季財報暨10月營收，受惠AI基礎建設投資持續擴大，帶動資料中心互連(DCI)需求強勁成長，推升產品出貨規模成長，單季稅後純益為7,935.7萬元、年增高達193.87%，每股稅後盈餘為2.06元，計前3季稅後純益為1.93億元、EPS達5.02元，整體營運同樣由虧轉盈，呈現穩健成長態勢。
據統新公告，10月營收為7,874.6萬元、年增60.7％，累計今年1至10月合併營收達6.56億元、年增65.74％。法人展望統新第4季，預期隨著AI資料中心高速光通訊需求持續增溫，客戶訂單動能維持強勁，加上營運管理優化效益逐步顯現，對統新第4季營運成長前景持樂觀態度。
此外，統新也自結今年第3季財報，單季合併營收為2.16億元，較去年同期成長60.58％；稅後純益為7,935.7萬、季減7.28％、年增193.87％，前3季累計稅後純益為1.93億元、EPS為5.02元，同較去年虧轉盈。
為因應客戶訂單需求及中長期業務成長，統新表示，公司將持續擴充產能，資本支出規模預期將進一步增加，主要用於新增產線及提升生產設備效能。
另統新董事會已於今5月、8月及10月已陸續核准生產設備資本支出預算，統新最新將規劃進一步追加預算，相關新增設備採購將於今年11月董事會通過後陸續執行。
統新預計，通過資本支出案，部分新產線將於2027年第１季起陸續到位，帶動月產能逐步提升，進一步強化接單與供貨能力，為後續營運成長奠定基礎。
paras_en: Optical‑communication filter maker Tong Hsin (6426‑TW) released its Q3 financial results and October revenue today (Oct 10). Benefiting from continued expansion of AI infrastructure investment, demand for data‑center interconnect (DCI) has surged, driving strong growth in product shipments. Net profit after tax for the quarter was NT$79.357 million, up 193.87% year‑over‑year, and earnings per share (EPS) were NT$2.06. For the first three quarters, net profit after tax totaled NT$193 million, yielding an EPS of NT$5.02, marking a turnaround to profitability and a solid growth trajectory.

According to Tong Hsin’s announcement, October revenue reached NT$78.746 million, a 60.7% year‑over‑year increase, and cumulative revenue for January‑October this year hit NT$656 million, up 65.74% YoY. Analysts are optimistic about the company’s Q4 outlook, expecting AI data‑center high‑speed optical communication demand to stay hot, customer order momentum to remain strong, and operational‑management efficiencies to materialize, all supporting a positive growth outlook for Q4.

The company also reported that Q3 consolidated revenue was NT$216 million, a 60.58% increase from the same period last year. Net profit after tax was NT$79.357 million, down 7.28% sequentially but up 193.87% year‑over‑year. Cumulative net profit after tax for the first three quarters was NT$193 million, with EPS of NT$5.02, again reflecting a swing from loss to profit compared with the prior year.

To meet customer order demand and support mid‑ to long‑term business growth, Tong Hsin said it will continue to expand capacity, with capital expenditures expected to rise further, primarily to fund new production lines and upgrade manufacturing equipment efficiency.

The board of directors has approved capital‑expenditure budgets for production equipment in May, August and October of this year. Tong Hsin now plans to add additional budget, with procurement of the new equipment to be carried out after board approval in November this year.

Through the approved capital‑expenditure plan, several new production lines are slated to come online starting Q1 2027, gradually increasing monthly capacity, strengthening order‑taking and supply capabilities, and laying a foundation for future operational growth.

items.title: Claude開發商拚本月上市！Anthropic開價70至78美元 台積電、輝達參與私募
items.title_en: Claude Developer Aims for IPO This Month! Anthropic Prices Shares at $70-$78, TSMC and Nvidia Join Private Placement
paras: 綜合外媒報導，Claude開發商Anthropic周二(10日)公布首次公開發行(IPO)價格區間，每股70至78美元，連同科技大廠參與的私募，合計籌資規模最高約904億美元。公司力拚成為首家上市的前沿人工智慧(AI)實驗室，但AI股近期震盪、基礎設施支出攀升，也讓這場上市案成為市場信心的重要考驗。
Anthropic預計本月以「ANT」為代號登上那斯達克，將發售8.25億股，其中8.014億股為公司發行，另2,360萬股由既有股東出售。按價格上限計算，IPO總規模約643.5億美元，並非全數流入公司。

台積電輝達參與私募 估值上看兆美元

另有260億美元將透過私募籌集，參與者包括超微(AMD-US)、博通(AVGO-US)、Alphabet旗下Google(GOOGL-US)、美光(MU-US)、微軟(MSFT-US)、輝達(NVDA-US)及台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)，認購價格與IPO相同。
按發行價上限及流通在外股數計算，Anthropic市值約1兆美元；若採完全稀釋基礎，估值則約1.405兆美元，高於5月募資時的9,650億美元，仍低於先前瞄準的2兆美元。
IPO加計私募後，籌資目標將超越SpaceX的750億美元基本發行規模，但單看IPO部分仍較小。美國期中選舉後，資料中心開發限制可能增加，加上市場擔憂利率上升推高融資成本，均為此次募資增添變數。

營收暴增仍轉虧 龐大算力承諾考驗獲利

Anthropic第三季營收接近170億美元，遠高於去年同期14億美元；前三季營收332.4億美元，年增約1,200%。然而，第三季營業費用增至175億美元，年增292%，使公司從第二季營業獲利9.74億美元，轉為營業虧損5.67億美元。
第三季虧損主要受到50億美元短期算力支出，以及慈善捐款配對計畫相關20億美元非現金費用影響。前三季淨損達1,040億美元，但大部分來自可轉換票據及衍生負債的公允價值變動，不能直接視為現金消耗。
更大的考驗在於，公司承諾支出達8,950億美元，多數涉及算力與晶片，其中約700億美元須在截至2027年9月的一年內支付。同時，模型降價與客戶合約折扣，使第三季營收增幅減少約6億美元。
Anthropic周一推出新版Fable與Mythos模型，提升速度並降低Fable價格。隨低價模型競爭加劇，公司能否讓營收成長超越基礎設施成本，將是投資人評估其兆美元估值的關鍵。
paras_en: According to foreign media reports, Anthropic, the developer of Claude, announced on Tuesday (the 10th) its initial public offering (IPO) price range of $70 to $78 per share. Including a private placement involving major tech firms, the total fundraising could reach up to about $90.4 billion. The company is pushing to become the first frontier artificial‑intelligence (AI) lab to go public, but recent volatility in AI stocks and rising infrastructure spending make the listing a key test of market confidence.

Anthropic plans to list on Nasdaq this month under the ticker “ANT,” offering 825 million shares, of which 801.4 million will be issued by the company and 23.6 million will be sold by existing shareholders. At the top of the price range, the IPO would amount to roughly $64.35 billion, not all of which would flow to the company.

Another $26 billion will be raised through a private placement, with participants including AMD, Broadcom (AVGO), Google (Alphabet), Micron, Microsoft, Nvidia and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC). The purchase price for the private‑placement shares is the same as the IPO price.

Using the upper‑range issue price and the shares that will be publicly floated, Anthropic’s market value would be about $1 trillion; on a fully diluted basis the valuation rises to roughly $1.405 trillion, higher than the $965 billion raised in May but still below the earlier target of $2 trillion.

Including the private placement, the fundraising goal would surpass SpaceX’s baseline $75 billion offering, though the IPO portion alone remains smaller. After the U.S. mid‑term elections, potential limits on data‑center development and market worries about rising interest rates increasing financing costs add uncertainty to the raise.

Anthropic’s third‑quarter revenue approached $17 billion, far above the $1.4 billion in the same period last year; revenue for the first three quarters totaled $33.24 billion, up about 1,200% year‑over‑year. However, Q3 operating expenses jumped to $17.5 billion, a 292% increase, turning a Q2 operating profit of $974 million into an operating loss of $567 million.

The Q3 loss was driven mainly by $5 billion in short‑term compute spending and $2 billion of non‑cash expenses related to a charitable‑matching program. Net loss for the first three quarters reached $104 billion, most of which stemmed from fair‑value changes in convertible notes and derivative liabilities and should not be viewed as cash outflow.

A larger challenge is the company’s commitment to spend $895 billion, mostly on compute and chips, with about $70 billion due within one year ending September 2027. At the same time, model price cuts and customer contract discounts trimmed the Q3 revenue growth by roughly $600 million.

Anthropic launched updated Fable and Mythos models on Monday, boosting speed and lowering the price of Fable. As competition intensifies in the low‑price model segment, whether the company can grow revenue faster than its infrastructure costs will be the key factor investors use to assess its trillion‑dollar valuation.

items.title: AI資料中心需求強勁 英飛凌上修2027財年營收目標至200億歐元
items.title_en: Strong AI Data Center Demand Leads Infineon to Raise FY2027 Revenue Target to €20 Billion
paras: 德國電源半導體大廠英飛凌(Infineon)發布最新預測，在 AI 資料中心強勁需求的推動下，預估 2027 財年整體營收將達到約 200 億歐元，年成長超過 20%。
其中，資料中心業務營收目標大幅上調至 40 億歐元(原估 25 億歐元)，包含 AI 資料中心電源解決方案約 35 億歐元與傳統資料中心約 5 億歐元。
英飛凌執行長漢貝克(Jochen Hanebeck)表示，公司以「持續強勁的動能」進入新財年。「我們預計 2027 財年的營收與獲利能力將顯著改善。」
他指出，資料中心電源晶片、能源基礎設施升級、電動車(EV)及軟體定義車輛(SDV)是驅動成長的核心主軸。為滿足需求，英飛凌計畫投入 30 億至 35 億歐元資本支出，用於德國德勒斯登、馬來西亞居林(碳化矽 SiC)及奧地利菲拉赫(12 吋氮化鎵 GaN)等廠區擴產。
摩根大通分析師Sandeep Deshpande在報告中分析，英飛凌過往習慣先給出較為保守的指引，待市場能見度提升後再進行調整。他補充稱，本次上修後的 40 億歐元目標已達到摩根大通原先預估區間(35 億至 40 億歐元)的頂標。
財務表現方面，英飛凌 2026 財年第四季營收達 47.06 億歐元，全年營收為 163.53 億歐元，董事會擬將每股股利調升至 0.38 歐元。
paras_en: German power semiconductor leader Infineon announced its latest forecast, projecting overall revenue for fiscal year 2027 to reach roughly €20 billion, driven by strong demand for AI data centers, representing an annual growth of over 20%.

The data‑center business revenue target was sharply increased to €4 billion (up from €2.5 billion), comprising about €3.5 billion for AI data‑center power solutions and €0.5 billion for traditional data centers.
Infineon CEO Jochen Hanebeck said the company is entering the new fiscal year with “sustained strong momentum.” “We expect revenue and profitability in FY2027 to improve markedly,” he added.

He highlighted that data‑center power chips, energy‑infrastructure upgrades, electric vehicles (EVs) and software‑defined vehicles (SDVs) are the core growth drivers. To meet demand, Infineon plans to invest €3‑3.5 billion in capital expenditures for capacity expansions at its Dresden (Germany) site, a silicon‑carbide (SiC) plant in Kulim, Malaysia, and a 12‑inch gallium‑nitride (GaN) facility in Filz, Austria.

JPMorgan analyst Sandeep Deshpande noted that Infineon traditionally gives conservative guidance and revises it once market visibility improves. He added that the revised €4 billion target now sits at the top of JPMorgan’s original forecast range of €3.5‑€4 billion.
In terms of financial performance, Infineon posted Q4 FY2026 revenue of €4.706 billion, with full‑year revenue of €16.353 billion, and the board intends to raise the dividend to €0.38 per share.

items.title: 美10月CPI今夜揭曉：年增率罕見缺席  月增放緩能否撼動聯準會12月升息預期？
items.title_en: US October CPI Revealed Tonight: Rare Absence of Year‑Over‑Year Rate, Can Slower Monthly Rise Undermine Fed’s December Rate‑Hike Expectations?
paras: 美國勞工統計局(BLS)將在台灣時間今晚9點半公佈10月消費者物價指數(CPI)，這是聯準會(Fed)12月開會前最後一份完整通膨數據，但受去年10月美國聯邦政府停擺導致當月數據採集缺失影響，BLS將罕見不發佈整體與核心CPI年增數據，市場只能完全依賴月增率與細項價格判斷通膨路徑。
接受《路透社》調查的經濟學家預估，10月CPI料將月增0.3%，較9月0.6%的四年來最大單月漲幅明顯下滑，核心CPI料將月增0.2%，創三個月新低。
花旗表示，能源向其他商品傳導有限，服務價格將維持溫和；彭博經濟研究則估算月增約0.25%、核心約0.24%，二手車、消費電子與住房服務是關鍵變量。
不過物價壓力遠未消散。國際油價上周雖跌破每桶100美元，但年初至今仍上漲近60%，天然氣價格高企推升運輸、製造終端成本。
企業端感受尤為明顯。根據《彭博資訊》統計數據，標普500成分股10月財報電話會提及「通膨」多達820次，創2024年2月以來峰值。
機構對核心CPI底層分項分歧顯著，高盛預期最為鴿派，估核心CPI月增率僅0.16%，受醫療保險數據更新拖累醫保分項驟降2.5%、中古車跌1.5%、業主等價租金(OER)回落至0.26%。
德銀預估10月核心CPI月增0.2%，提示娛樂與IT商品漲價將對沖部分降幅；摩根大通則偏向韌性，給出0.23%。
值得注意的是，高盛指出BLS採用9月與11月幾何平均插補缺失月份，殘留季節性偏差可能額外推高10月核心CPI約0.05個百分點。且核心CPI疲軟未必完全傳導至Fed更看重的PCE。高盛預估10月核心PCE月增率仍將達0.23%，德銀則估計年增率將維持3.1%高位。
若今晚核心CPI明顯低於0.2%，有望緩和市場對Fed激進緊縮的押注；一旦超預期反彈，美債殖利率與美元料再度飆升，全球風險資產將面臨重估。
至於週五(13日)出爐的生產者物價指數(PPI)將進一步驗證生產端成本傳導，為Fed路徑提供補充拼圖。市場預估10月PPI年增6.6%、創近四年新高，
paras_en: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) will release the October Consumer Price Index (CPI) at 9:30 p.m. Taiwan time tonight, the last full‑inflation data point before the Fed’s December meeting. Because data collection was disrupted by the U.S. federal government shutdown in October last year, the BLS will unusually omit the overall and core CPI year‑over‑year figures, leaving the market to rely entirely on the month‑over‑month rates and component prices to gauge the inflation path.

Economists surveyed by Reuters expect October CPI to rise 0.3% month‑over‑month, a sharp slowdown from September’s 0.6% – the biggest single‑month gain in four years. Core CPI is projected to increase 0.2% month‑over‑month, a three‑month low.

Citigroup says energy price gains will have limited spillover to other goods and services prices will stay modest; Bloomberg Economics estimates a month‑over‑month rise of about 0.25% for overall CPI and about 0.24% for core, with used cars, consumer electronics and housing services as key variables.

Nevertheless, price pressures are far from gone. International oil prices fell below $100 a barrel last week but are still up nearly 60% year‑to‑date, and high natural‑gas prices are pushing up transportation and manufacturing costs.

The impact on companies is especially evident. Bloomberg data show that references to “inflation” were made 820 times during October earnings calls by S&P 500 constituents, the highest level since February 2024.

Institutions differ sharply on the underlying components of core CPI. Goldman Sachs is the most dovish, forecasting a core CPI month‑over‑month increase of only 0.16%, with a 2.5% drop in the medical‑insurance component, a 1.5% decline in used‑car prices and owner‑equivalent rent (OER) easing to 0.26%.

Deutsche Bank projects a 0.2% month‑over‑month rise in October core CPI, noting that price gains in entertainment and IT goods will offset part of the decline; JPMorgan leans toward resilience, giving a 0.23% estimate.

Goldman points out that the BLS uses a geometric average of September and November to fill the missing October data, leaving a seasonal bias that could add roughly 0.05 percentage points to the October core CPI. Moreover, a weak core CPI may not fully translate to the Fed’s preferred PCE measure. Goldman still expects October core PCE to rise 0.23% month‑over‑month, while Deutsche Bank forecasts the year‑over‑year rate to stay near a high 3.1%.

If tonight’s core CPI comes in clearly below 0.2%, market bets on aggressive Fed tightening could ease; a surprise rebound would likely send U.S. Treasury yields and the dollar higher again, prompting a reassessment of global risk assets.

Friday’s (the 13th) Producer Price Index (PPI) release will further test the pass‑through of production‑side costs and add another piece to the Fed’s puzzle. Markets expect October PPI to rise 6.6% year‑over‑year, a near‑four‑year high.

items.title: 水泥雙雄10月營收 台泥163.57億元創22個月新高、亞泥雙減
items.title_en: Cement Twins October Revenue: Taiwan Cement Posts NT$16.357 B 22‑Month High, Asia Cement Declines
paras: 水泥雙雄公布10月營收，台泥(1101-TW)10月營收163.57億元，創2025年1月以來近22個月新高，月增14.2%、年增17.83%；不過，亞泥(1102-TW)10月營收54.31億元，月減19%、年減6.9%，呈現不同調。累計前10月，台泥營收1,294.05億元，年增4.93%；亞泥累計營收則為558.45億元，年減5.3%。
台泥表示，10月營收成長主要來自能源及儲能業務，水泥事業亦受惠中國大陸市場量價回升，以及葡萄牙水泥市場穩健成長，營收較去年同期增加。其中，能源事業單月及累計營收均較去年成長，NHOA受惠旗下NHOA Energy儲能工程(EPC)案件量增加，成為10月主要成長動能之一；台泥循環鋰電池出貨量也增加，帶動營收成長。
兩岸水泥事業方面，台泥表示，10月營收較去年同期增加6.29億元，累計前10月增加26.11億元。雖然中國大陸市場整體需求仍偏緩，但受惠十一假期後需求增加、價格回升，銷量較去年同期增加；台灣市場則受房貸限貸措施、房市政策及進口低價水泥競爭影響，需求仍偏緩。
亞泥表示，10月營收較去年同期減少，主要受到兩岸水泥銷售表現及台灣預拌混凝土業務變化影響。台灣市場方面，水泥及預拌混凝土銷量下降，加上電力收入減少，市場營收年減9%；大陸市場則因水泥售價年增3%，部分抵銷銷量年減14%的影響，市場營收年減3%。
若與9月相比，亞泥台灣市場營收月減27%，主要受到預拌混凝土量價同步下滑，以及轉投資收入減少影響；大陸市場方面，雖水泥銷量減少6%，但售價進一步上漲7%，帶動營收月增1%，顯示價格回升對營收具有一定支撐。亞泥表示，營運仍受到兩岸市場需求及價格變化影響，將持續透過多元事業布局及營運管理，穩健推動各項業務發展。
paras_en: The two cement giants released their October revenues: Taiwan Cement (1101‑TW) posted NT$163.57 billion for the month, a 22‑month high since January 2025, up 14.2% month‑over‑month and 17.83% year‑over‑year; Asia Cement (1102‑TW) reported NT$54.31 billion, down 19% month‑over‑month and 6.9% year‑over‑year, showing a divergent trend. For the first ten months of the year, Taiwan Cement’s cumulative revenue reached NT$1,294.05 billion, a 4.93% increase year‑over‑year, while Asia Cement’s cumulative revenue was NT$558.45 billion, a 5.3% decline year‑over‑year.

Taiwan Cement said the October revenue growth came mainly from its energy and energy‑storage businesses, while its cement segment also benefited from a rebound in volume and price in the mainland China market and steady growth in Portugal’s cement market, resulting in higher revenue compared with the same period last year. In the energy segment, both monthly and cumulative revenues rose year‑over‑year; NHOA gained from an increase in NHOA Energy storage‑project (EPC) orders, becoming one of the main growth drivers in October, and Taiwan Cement’s shipments of recycled lithium‑ion batteries also rose, contributing to revenue growth.

Regarding the cross‑strait cement business, Taiwan Cement noted that October revenue was NT$6.29 billion higher than the same month last year, and cumulative revenue for the first ten months was NT$26.11 billion higher. Although overall demand in mainland China remains sluggish, the post‑National‑Day holiday boost in demand and price recovery lifted sales versus last year; in Taiwan, demand stayed weak due to mortgage‑lending restrictions, housing‑market policies and competition from low‑priced imported cement.

Asia Cement said its October revenue fell versus the same month last year, mainly due to the performance of cement sales on both sides of the strait and changes in its Taiwan ready‑mix concrete business. In Taiwan, cement and ready‑mix concrete volumes declined, and lower electricity income reduced market revenue by 9% year‑over‑year; in the mainland market, cement prices rose 3% year‑over‑year, partially offsetting a 14% drop in volume, resulting in a 3% year‑over‑year decline in market revenue.

Compared with September, Asia Cement’s Taiwan‑market revenue dropped 27% month‑over‑month, driven by simultaneous declines in ready‑mix concrete volume and price as well as reduced investment‑income; in the mainland market, cement volume fell 6% but prices rose an additional 7%, lifting revenue by 1% month‑over‑month, indicating that price recovery provides some support. Asia Cement said its operations remain affected by demand and price shifts across the two markets, and it will continue to pursue steady business development through diversified business布局 and operational management.

items.title: 〈電信三雄財報〉台灣大前10月獲利144.5億元超越去年 EPS 4.74元續坐獲利王寶座
items.title_en: <Telecom Trio Earnings> Taiwan Mobile Leads with NT$14.45 B Profit in First 10 Months, EPS NT$4.74 Retains Profit King Crown
paras: 電信三雄今(10)日公告10月財務數字，台灣大(3045-TW)再度成為獲利王，累計今年前10月稅後純益達144.5億元，超越2025年全年獲利，每股純益達4.74元，高於中華電信(2412-TW)的4.71元，以及遠傳(4904-TW)的3.5元。

中華電信 

中華電信10月營收237.5億元，月減2.66%，年增13.47%；EBITDA 81億元，月減7.32%，年增7.86%；稅後純益35.9億元，月減19.14%，年增13.97%，每股純益0.46元。
中華電信累計今年前10月營收2126.9億元，年增11.12%；EBITDA 805.8億元，年增7.83%；稅後純益365.6億元，年增12.29%，每股純益4.71元。
中華電信指出，10月營收與EBITDA創歷年同期高，其中，營收成長受惠手機銷售延續9月動能，電信核心業務穩健成長，以及資通訊業務強勁攀升。此外，子公司也受惠AI需求持續成長，產品出貨動能提升，大幅挹注銷貨收入。
行動服務方面，受惠iPhone新機銷售熱絡帶動5G升速方案持續熱銷，高資費用戶穩健成長，加上月租型客戶數持續年增，帶動行動服務營收年增3.6%，月租型ARPU也年增2.8%至578元。固網寬頻業務則受惠AI與數位應用持續推升高速頻寬需求，10月300Mbps以上高速寬頻用戶數年增14.6%，帶動固網寬頻營收年增3.0%，國內電路出租營收同步躍升。
資通訊業務部分，10月營收年增39.9%，為營收成長的主要引擎。主要受惠大型IDC機房建置完工認列、電網儲能系統專案交付，以及海外子公司台商建廠專案完工挹注，帶動IDC及雲端、智慧聯網等相關營收皆年增5成以上。
中華電信持續深化AI布局與創新應用，10月子公司「中華曜智科技股份有限公司」正式成立，整合AI影像辨識、智慧安防及邊緣運算技術，聚焦企業安防、公共安全、智慧城市及創新影像應用，將AI技術實力轉化為智慧解決方案與成長動能。
在數位內容方面，中華電信深化影視內容投資布局，攜手中華數位文創公布多項投資計畫。透過多元投資、跨國共製及國際合作，推動台灣原創IP從內容開發、製作到海外市場拓展，擴大優質內容版圖與IP價值。

台灣大 

台灣大10月營收170.7億元，月減1.95%，年增9.28%；EBITDA 38.98億元，月增4.45%，年增14.31%；稅後純益15億元，月增2.04%，年增31.58%，每股純益0.48元。
台灣大累計今年前10月營收1666.4億元，年增5.74%；EBITDA 380.63億元，年增8.19%；稅後純益144.5億元，年增23.72%，每股純益4.74元。
Telco電信本業方面，新一代iPhone新機換機需求延續，推升單月銷貨收入年增雙位數；家用寬頻事業穩定成長，帶動家戶事業營收年增16%。
Telco+企業事業上，AIDC穩定貢獻營收，加上10月認列企業資通訊專案收入，挹注企業服務營收成長；Telco+Tech新科技事業部分，遊戲代理事業單月營收年增8%，品牌電商持續擴張，旗下代理品牌3COINS第二家實體店正式開幕，進一步擴大營運動能。
遠傳累計今年前10月營收978.48億元，年增10.33%；EBITDA 337.73億元，年增7.15%；稅後純益126.13億元，年增11.35%，每股純益3.5元。
遠傳指出，受惠iPhone新機上市帶動用戶升級5G、手機銷售表現優於去年同期，以及企業智慧資通訊業務穩健成長，10月營收創歷史單月新高。
行動通訊業務方面，遠傳10月總用戶數成長，月租型用戶流失率維持低檔。iPhone換機潮帶動5G升級，10月月租型用戶5G滲透率達到50.4%。月租型用戶每月平均貢獻度(ARPU)連續22個月年增，帶動行動服務營收達53.37億元
企業智慧資通訊業務延續成長動能，受惠雲端專案順利交付，營收維持雙位數成長；資安、智慧城市及物聯網等業務也同步成長，企業數位轉型需求持續發酵。
paras_en: The three major telecom operators announced their October financial figures today (the 10th). Taiwan Mobile (3045‑TW) again topped the profit chart, with cumulative net profit after tax of NT$14.45 billion for the first ten months of the year, surpassing its full‑year 2025 profit. Earnings per share reached NT$4.74, higher than Chunghwa Telecom (2412‑TW) at NT$4.71 and Far EasTone (4904‑TW) at NT$3.5.

Chunghwa Telecom: October revenue was NT$23.75 billion, down 2.66% month‑on‑month but up 13.47% year‑on‑year; EBITDA was NT$8.1 billion, down 7.32% month‑on‑month and up 7.86% year‑on‑year; net profit after tax was NT$3.59 billion, down 19.14% month‑on‑month and up 13.97% year‑on‑year, yielding earnings per share of NT$0.46.

For the first ten months, Chunghwa Telecom’s cumulative revenue reached NT$212.69 billion, up 11.12% year‑on‑year; EBITDA was NT$80.58 billion, up 7.83%; net profit after tax was NT$36.56 billion, up 12.29%, translating to earnings per share of NT$4.71.

Chunghwa Telecom noted that October revenue and EBITDA hit record highs for the same month in history. Revenue growth was driven by continued momentum in mobile phone sales from September, solid growth in core telecom services, and a strong rise in ICT services. In addition, subsidiaries benefited from sustained AI demand, boosting product shipments and significantly contributing to sales revenue.

In mobile services, robust iPhone sales spurred continued strong demand for 5G acceleration plans, while high‑value customers grew steadily. The number of postpaid customers kept increasing year‑on‑year, lifting mobile service revenue by 3.6% and raising postpaid ARPU by 2.8% to NT$578. Fixed‑line broadband benefited from AI and digital applications that drove higher demand for high‑speed bandwidth; users of 300 Mbps or faster broadband grew 14.6% year‑on‑year in October, pushing fixed‑line broadband revenue up 3.0% and boosting domestic circuit‑leasing revenue as well.

In the ICT segment, October revenue jumped 39.9% year‑on‑year, becoming the main engine of overall revenue growth. The surge was mainly due to the completion and recognition of large IDC data‑center projects, delivery of power‑grid energy‑storage system projects, and the completion of overseas subsidiary factory projects by Taiwanese investors, which lifted IDC, cloud, smart‑networking and related revenues by more than 50% each.

Chunghwa Telecom continues to deepen its AI footprint and innovative applications. In October, its subsidiary Chunghwa Yaozhi Technology Co., Ltd. was formally established, integrating AI image recognition, smart security and edge‑computing technologies. The unit focuses on enterprise security, public safety, smart cities and innovative imaging applications, turning AI expertise into intelligent solutions and growth momentum.

Regarding digital content, Chunghwa Telecom expanded its investment in film and television assets, partnering with Chunghwa Digital Cultural Creation to announce multiple investment projects. Through diversified investment, cross‑border co‑production and international collaboration, the company aims to promote Taiwanese original IP from development and production to overseas market expansion, enlarging the footprint and value of high‑quality content and IP.

Taiwan Mobile: October revenue was NT$17.07 billion, down 1.95% month‑on‑month but up 9.28% year‑on‑year; EBITDA was NT$3.898 billion, up 4.45% month‑on‑month and 14.31% year‑on‑year; net profit after tax was NT$1.5 billion, up 2.04% month‑on‑month and 31.58% year‑on‑year, yielding earnings per share of NT$0.48.

For the first ten months, Taiwan Mobile’s cumulative revenue reached NT$166.64 billion, up 5.74% year‑on‑year; EBITDA was NT$38.063 billion, up 8.19%; net profit after tax was NT$14.45 billion, up 23.72%, resulting in earnings per share of NT$4.74.

In its core telecom business, demand for the new generation iPhone continued to drive double‑digit year‑on‑year growth in monthly sales revenue. The residential broadband segment grew steadily, contributing to a 16% year‑on‑year increase in household‑business revenue.

In the Telco+ enterprise segment, AIDC consistently contributed to revenue, and October saw the recognition of enterprise ICT project income, bolstering enterprise service revenue growth. In the Telco+Tech new‑technology segment, game‑agency revenue rose 8% month‑on‑month, brand e‑commerce kept expanding, and the second physical store of its agency brand 3COINS opened, further enhancing operational momentum.

Far EasTone: October revenue was NT$11.618 billion, up 5.98% month‑on‑month and 5.31% year‑on‑year; EBITDA was NT$3.454 billion, up 1.71% month‑on‑month and 5.89% year‑on‑year; net profit after tax was NT$1.221 billion, down 5.5% month‑on‑month and 3.63% year‑on‑year, yielding earnings per share of NT$0.34.

For the first ten months, Far EasTone’s cumulative revenue reached NT$97.848 billion, up 10.33% year‑on‑year; EBITDA was NT$33.773 billion, up 7.15%; net profit after tax was NT$12.613 billion, up 11.35%, giving earnings per share of NT$3.5.

Far EasTone noted that the launch of the new iPhone boosted user upgrades to 5G, phone sales outperformed the same period last year, and enterprise smart‑ICT business grew steadily, leading to a record‑high single‑month revenue in October.

In mobile communications, Far EasTone’s total subscriber base grew in October, with postpaid churn remaining low. The iPhone upgrade wave drove 5G upgrades, pushing the postpaid 5G penetration rate to 50.4% in October. Postpaid ARPU increased year‑on‑year for 22 consecutive months, lifting mobile service revenue to NT$5.337 billion.

Enterprise smart‑ICT business maintained its growth momentum, benefiting from smooth delivery of cloud projects and achieving double‑digit revenue growth; cybersecurity, smart‑city and IoT businesses also expanded, as corporate digital‑transformation demand continued to ferment.

items.title: 統新前3Q EPS為5.02元較去年虧轉盈 新產線於2027年Q1起陸續量產
items.title_en: Tong Hsin's FYQ3 EPS at NT$5.02, Turning Profit from Last Year's Loss; New Production Lines to Commence Serial Production Starting Q1 2027
paras: 光通訊濾鏡廠統新(6426-TW)今(10)日自結第3季財報暨10月營收，受惠AI基礎建設投資持續擴大，帶動資料中心互連(DCI)需求強勁成長，推升產品出貨規模成長，單季稅後純益為7,935.7萬元、年增高達193.87%，每股稅後盈餘為2.06元，計前3季稅後純益為1.93億元、EPS達5.02元，整體營運同樣由虧轉盈，呈現穩健成長態勢。
據統新公告，10月營收為7,874.6萬元、年增60.7％，累計今年1至10月合併營收達6.56億元、年增65.74％。法人展望統新第4季，預期隨著AI資料中心高速光通訊需求持續增溫，客戶訂單動能維持強勁，加上營運管理優化效益逐步顯現，對統新第4季營運成長前景持樂觀態度。
此外，統新也自結今年第3季財報，單季合併營收為2.16億元，較去年同期成長60.58％；稅後純益為7,935.7萬、季減7.28％、年增193.87％，前3季累計稅後純益為1.93億元、EPS為5.02元，同較去年虧轉盈。
為因應客戶訂單需求及中長期業務成長，統新表示，公司將持續擴充產能，資本支出規模預期將進一步增加，主要用於新增產線及提升生產設備效能。
另統新董事會已於今5月、8月及10月已陸續核准生產設備資本支出預算，統新最新將規劃進一步追加預算，相關新增設備採購將於今年11月董事會通過後陸續執行。
統新預計，通過資本支出案，部分新產線將於2027年第１季起陸續到位，帶動月產能逐步提升，進一步強化接單與供貨能力，為後續營運成長奠定基礎。
paras_en: Optical‑communication filter maker Tong Hsin (6426‑TW) released its Q3 financial results and October revenue today (Oct 10). Benefiting from continued expansion of AI infrastructure investment, demand for data‑center interconnect (DCI) has surged, driving strong growth in product shipments. Net profit after tax for the quarter was NT$79.357 million, up 193.87% year‑over‑year, and earnings per share (EPS) were NT$2.06. For the first three quarters, net profit after tax totaled NT$193 million, yielding an EPS of NT$5.02, marking a turnaround to profitability and a solid growth trajectory.

According to Tong Hsin’s announcement, October revenue reached NT$78.746 million, a 60.7% year‑over‑year increase, and cumulative revenue for January‑October this year hit NT$656 million, up 65.74% YoY. Analysts are optimistic about the company’s Q4 outlook, expecting AI data‑center high‑speed optical communication demand to stay hot, customer order momentum to remain strong, and operational‑management efficiencies to materialize, all supporting a positive growth outlook for Q4.

The company also reported that Q3 consolidated revenue was NT$216 million, a 60.58% increase from the same period last year. Net profit after tax was NT$79.357 million, down 7.28% sequentially but up 193.87% year‑over‑year. Cumulative net profit after tax for the first three quarters was NT$193 million, with EPS of NT$5.02, again reflecting a swing from loss to profit compared with the prior year.

To meet customer order demand and support mid‑ to long‑term business growth, Tong Hsin said it will continue to expand capacity, with capital expenditures expected to rise further, primarily to fund new production lines and upgrade manufacturing equipment efficiency.

The board of directors has approved capital‑expenditure budgets for production equipment in May, August and October of this year. Tong Hsin now plans to add additional budget, with procurement of the new equipment to be carried out after board approval in November this year.

Through the approved capital‑expenditure plan, several new production lines are slated to come online starting Q1 2027, gradually increasing monthly capacity, strengthening order‑taking and supply capabilities, and laying a foundation for future operational growth.

items.title: 台揚淨值轉負 證交所：12月21日起終止上市
items.title_en: Taiyang Net Asset Turns Negative; Taiwan Stock Exchange: Delisting Effective Dec. 21
paras: 網通廠台揚(2314-TW)今(10)日召開重大訊息記者會說明最新財務狀況，宣布公司淨值已轉為負數。臺灣證券交易所隨後發布公告指出，因台揚財報顯示淨值轉負，已觸及營業細則相關規定，其上市有價證券將於2026年12月21日起正式終止上市。
證交所表示，台揚先前因符合營業細則第49條第1項第1款、第3款及第49條之2第1項第4款規定，其股票已被列為變更交易方法(全額交割)並採行分盤集合競價交易在案。
今日台揚依法申報之最新財務報告顯示淨值已轉為負數，核有證交所營業細則第50條之1第1項第9款規定之情事。因此，證交所依規公告，宣布台揚股票將於今年12月21日終止上市。
台揚今日暫停交易一天，已依規定完成重大訊息說明，證交所公告其上市普通股將自明(11)日起恢復交易，供市場投資人進行最後處置與交易操作。市場專家提醒投資人，股票雖恢復交易，但距終止上市僅剩一個多月時間，應特別注意流動性風險與投資權益。
paras_en: Taiyang (2314‑TW) held a major news conference today (Oct 10) to explain its latest financial condition, announcing that the company’s net assets have turned negative. The Taiwan Stock Exchange subsequently issued a notice stating that, because Taiyang’s financial statements show a negative net asset position, it has triggered the relevant provisions of the listing rules, and its listed securities will be formally delisted starting Dec 21, 2026.

The exchange noted that Taiyang had previously been classified under Article 49, Paragraph 1, Items 1 and 3, and Article 49‑2, Paragraph 1, Item 4 of the listing rules, resulting in its shares being subject to a change in trading method (full‑cash settlement) and to a split‑lot collective auction trading arrangement.

Taiyang’s latest financial report filed today legally confirms that its net assets have turned negative, meeting the circumstances described in Article 50‑1, Paragraph 1, Item 9 of the exchange’s listing rules. Accordingly, the exchange announced that Taiyang’s shares will be delisted on Dec 21 this year.

Taiyang suspended trading for one day today, having fulfilled the required major‑information disclosure. The exchange announced that its common shares will resume trading on the 11th, allowing market participants to conduct final disposals and transactions. Market experts caution investors that, although trading resumes, there is just over a month left before delisting, so liquidity risk and investment rights should be closely monitored.

items.title: 安倉營造明起執行庫藏股護盤  將在每股29.8元以下買回2000張
items.title_en: Ancang Construction to Begin Treasury‑Share Stabilization Tomorrow, Will Repurchase 2,000 Lots at Up to NT$29.8 per Share
paras: 安倉營造(5548-TW)除在日前成功籌組20億元聯貸案，並完成簽約後，並在公共工程得標喜訊，安倉營造與與順野電機共同投標，合力拿下「高雄國際機場新航廈工程計畫-第一期建設計畫-站前交通及設施改善工程」採購案的公開招標。手中工程案量已超過100億元，公司決議明(11)日起兩個月買回2000張庫藏股護盤。
這是安倉營造上櫃以來首度執行買回庫藏股護盤的措施，買回2000張庫藏股區間在13.5元至29.8元，價格低於13.5元也得以繼續買進，用途在轉讓給員工。
同時，今天安倉營造通過最新財報，2026年1-9月營收20.09億元，稅後純益8229萬元，年增24.15%，每股純益爲1.32元。
安倉股價今天收盤價報19.7元。
paras_en: Ancang Construction (5548‑TW) has just completed a successful NT$20 billion syndicated loan and signed the agreement. It also announced winning a public‑sector contract: together with Shun‑ye Electric, it secured the open tender for the “Kaohsiung International Airport New Terminal Project – Phase 1 Construction – Station‑area Transportation and Facility Improvement Works.” With a pipeline of projects now exceeding NT$10 billion, the company resolved to buy back 2,000 lots of treasury shares over the next two months starting tomorrow (the 11th) to support the share price.

This is the first time Ancang Construction has implemented a treasury‑share buyback for price support since its listing on the OTC market. The repurchase range is NT$13.5 to NT$29.8 per share, and purchases can continue below NT$13.5. The shares are intended for future transfer to employees.

Ancang Construction reported record revenue of NT$3.93 billion for October 2026, a year‑over‑year increase of 118%. For the period January‑October 2026, revenue reached NT$24.02 billion, up 21.86% year‑over‑year.

In its latest financial report, Ancang posted revenue of NT$20.09 billion for January‑September 2026, with a net profit after tax of NT$82.29 million, a 24.15% year‑over‑year rise, and earnings per share of NT$1.32.
Ancang’s stock closed today at NT$19.7 per share.

items.title: 黃仁勳風波重挫輝達！木頭姐反手掃進逾9萬股
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Scandal Slams Nvidia! Cathie Wood Swings In Over 90,000 Shares
paras: 據《巴隆周刊》報導，輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳因與一名被美方懷疑涉及中國情報活動的企業主管有感情關係，面臨美國聯邦調查局(FBI)調查。不過，有「木頭姐」之稱的方舟投資(ARK Invest)創辦人伍德(Cathie Wood)，仍透過旗下基金在股價下挫之際買進逾9萬股，顯示這場風波尚未動搖部分投資人的信心。
輝達周一因黃仁勳承認婚外情，以及董事會將展開獨立調查的消息，收盤下跌4.3%；周二(10日)盤前則反彈1.8%，報181.85美元，顯示部分資金開始逢低承接，但買盤態度仍偏審慎。
川普周一向記者透露，FBI正調查黃仁勳與Megaspeed International前高階主管黃樂(Alice Huang)的感情關係。兩人並無親屬關係，美國官員懷疑黃樂曾向中國政府提供資訊，相關指控仍待調查釐清。
Megaspeed未回應置評請求，黃樂也未能取得聯繫。不過，Megaspeed周一在LinkedIn發布聲明表示，美國當局及其他單位的調查，並未發現涉及非法轉移晶片或其他非法活動的違規證據。
在股價承壓之際，伍德旗下基金選擇加碼。方舟周一公布的交易資料顯示，旗下ETF合計買進90,443股輝達；若以當日收盤價估算，這批股票價值略高於1,600萬美元，實際成交金額則可能有所不同。
《巴隆周刊》認為，只要黃仁勳未被迫離職，輝達股票仍值得持有。該刊指出，公司目前缺乏明確接班計畫，調查結果必須揭露極為嚴重的問題，才足以支持撤換黃仁勳。這是該刊的投資判斷，並不代表調查結果已經明朗。
伍德以押注基因科技、機器人等高成長領域聞名，並因重押特斯拉(TSLA-US)建立知名度，但投資績效並非一路順遂。她旗下規模最大的方舟創新ETF(ARKK-US)，過去五年平均每年虧損約4.1%。
目前華爾街分析師對最新消息尚未出現明顯反應。FactSet資料顯示，輝達平均目標價仍約332美元，反映分析師整體上仍看好其股價前景，但後續調查進展及黃仁勳能否繼續掌舵，仍是投資人關注焦點。
paras_en: According to Barron's, Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang is under FBI investigation for a romantic relationship with a corporate executive suspected of Chinese intelligence activities. Nevertheless, Cathie Wood, founder of ARK Invest, bought more than 90,000 shares through her funds as the stock fell, showing that the controversy has not shaken confidence among some investors.

Nvidia fell 4.3% on Monday after Huang admitted to an extramarital affair and the board announced an independent investigation. On Tuesday (the 10th) the stock rebounded 1.8% in pre‑market trading to $181.85, indicating that some capital is stepping in on the dip, though buying remains cautious.

President Trump told reporters on Monday that the FBI is probing Huang’s relationship with former Megaspeed International executive Alice Huang. The two are not related, and U.S. officials suspect Alice Huang may have passed information to the Chinese government, a claim that remains under investigation.

Megaspeed did not respond to comment requests, and Alice Huang could not be reached. However, Megaspeed posted a LinkedIn statement on Monday saying that investigations by U.S. authorities and other agencies have found no evidence of illegal chip transfers or other wrongdoing.

While the stock was under pressure, Wood’s funds chose to add to their positions. ARK disclosed on Monday that its ETFs bought a total of 90,443 Nvidia shares; at Monday’s closing price that tranche is worth just over $16 million, though the actual transaction amount may differ.

Barron’s believes Nvidia shares remain a hold as long as Huang is not forced out. The magazine notes the company lacks a clear succession plan and that only a disclosure of extremely serious findings would justify removing Huang. This is the publication’s investment view and does not imply the investigation’s outcome is known.

Wood is known for betting on high‑growth areas such as genomics and robotics and gained fame for her heavy Tesla (TSLA‑US) bets, but her investment track record has not been uniformly positive. Her largest fund, the ARK Innovation ETF (ARKK‑US), has averaged an annual loss of about 4.1% over the past five years.

Wall Street analysts have not yet shown a clear reaction to the latest news. FactSet data shows Nvidia’s average target price remains around $332, reflecting overall analyst optimism about the stock’s outlook, though the investigation’s progress and whether Huang can stay at the helm remain key concerns for investors.

items.title: Anthropic招股意外泄露融資細節！台積電等7大科技巨頭傳砸260億美元投資、估值遭下修
paras: 人工智慧（AI）新創公司Anthropic的首次公開募股（IPO）進程出現插曲。《路透》報導指出，Anthropic日前向承銷銀行發送一份包含股票發行數量及定價區間的招股文件，卻隨後發出更正通知，坦承文件中的定價資訊有誤，並表示將另行提供更新版本。此外，潛在投資者對Anthropic的估值預期大幅下調，上市時機與定價合理性同時受到質疑。
根據《路透》取得的週一（9日）電子郵件，Anthropic最初提供的文件顯示，公司計畫以每股70至80美元發行約8.67億股A類普通股，預計募資最高可達693億美元。
此外，輝達(NVDA-US) 、超微半導體(AMD-US) 、博通(AVGO-US) 、美光科技(MU-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 及台積電(2330-TW) 等科技巨頭，據稱將以IPO發行價合計投入260億美元，參與私募配售。
不過，Anthropic隨後寄出的第二封郵件明確指出，先前文件中的定價細節有誤，公司將在稍後更新招股文件。
與此同時，Anthropic的IPO計畫正面臨嚴峻考驗。在科技股遭遇重挫、那斯達克100指數單日暴跌6.4%之後，潛在投資者對這家A​​I公司的估值預期大幅下調，上市時機與定價合理性同時受到質疑。
知情人士透露，部分潛在投資者目前討論的估值區間已降至1.2兆至1.3兆美元。

IPO規模上看數百億美元 七大科技巨頭傳參與投資

Anthropic最初發送給銀行人士的文件，不僅揭露預計發行股數及價格區間，也列出大型科技企業參與私募配售的安排。
按照原始文件內容，公司計畫發行約8.67億股A類普通股，若以每股70至80美元計算，募資金額最高可達693億美元。
參與私募配售的七家科技巨頭，則涵蓋AI晶片設計、半導體製造及雲端運算等產業環節，顯示這宗IPO可能牽動整個AI供應鏈。
此外，文件也顯示，基石投資者預計在此次IPO中出售約2,333萬股既有股份。這部分屬於老股轉讓，資金將流向出售股份的投資者，而非Anthropic本身。因此，此次上市計畫同時涉及公司新股發行及既有股東出售持股。
不過，Anthropic隨即撤回先前披露的定價資訊，市場目前仍須等待經修正的正式文件，才能確認實際發行規模及相關條件。

傳最快11月10日啟動路演 目標下周四、五掛牌

儘管招股文件出現錯誤，Anthropic的上市時程仍已進入關鍵階段。
根據《彭博》報導，Anthropic於10月26日公開提交招股書後，依照相關規定，最快可於11月10日啟動正式IPO路演。公司目標是在11月16日當周完成定價，並趕在11月26日美國感恩節假期前於那斯達克掛牌，預計股票代號為「ANT」。
不過，近期市場波動也使Anthropic的估值面臨調整壓力。數月前，市場曾討論公司估值可能達到2兆美元，但這項預期如今已明顯降溫。
《彭博》6日引述知情人士報導，部分潛在投資者討論的估值已降至約1.2兆至1.3兆美元，甚至有人考慮將估值下修至1.1兆美元。
此前，投資人在10月公司財務簡報後向承銷銀行給出的估值為1.4兆至1.5兆美元，而今年10月初的預期高峰一度高達2兆美元。上述知情人士表示，相關討論仍在進行中，尚未形成最終決定。 Anthropic發言人拒絕置評。
報導指出，Anthropic本周已安排與關鍵投資者會面，目標是讓股票於下周四或周五開始交易。不過，公司仍可能延後估值目標，等待更有利的市場環境，但此舉也可能引發市場恐慌。

items.title: AI新創Anthropic擬募資最高904億美元台積電、輝達列基石投資人
items.title_en: AI Startup Anthropic Plans to Raise Up to $90.4 Billion, TSMC and Nvidia Named Cornerstone Investors
paras: 2026年11月10日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI新創Anthropic啟動上市路演，募資規模最高上看904億美元。11月10日公布的申報文件顯示，首次公開發行（IPO）規模最高644億美元，另計畫向基石投資人私募260億美元；依文件所列流通股數估算，估值最高約1.02兆美元，低於市場先前討論的1.5兆美元。
IPO暫定價格區間為每股70至78美元，由Anthropic及部分既有股東出售股票，因此IPO總額並不全數流入公司。基石投資人包括台積電(2330-TW)、輝達(NVDA-US)、超微(AMD-US)、博通(AVGO-US)、美光(MU-US)、微軟(MSFT-US)及Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google。發行價格仍待最終確定，完成IPO後預計以「ANT」為代號在那斯達克掛牌。
Claude模型需求帶動Anthropic第三季營收季增47%，達169.6億美元，淨損也縮小，但營收增速已低於第二季的144%。公司表示，成長來自Claude快速普及，包括針對醫療、金融及法律服務等產業推出的專門產品。
營收擴張背後伴隨龐大算力支出。Anthropic對亞馬遜(AMZN-US)、Google等夥伴的算力採購承諾接近9,000億美元，部分未來產能能否落實，取決於公司無法完全掌控的外部融資。在借貸成本偏高、投資人更重視AI投資回報之際，這次上市將同時考驗市場對Claude成長前景與長期資金需求的評價。

paras_en: On November 10, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – AI startup Anthropic launched its IPO roadshow, targeting a maximum fundraising of $90.4 billion. Documents filed on November 10 show the IPO could be as large as $64.4 billion, with an additional $26 billion planned for a private placement to cornerstone investors; based on the listed share count, the peak valuation is estimated at about $1.02 trillion, below the previously discussed $1.5 trillion.

The tentative IPO price range is $70 to $78 per share, with Anthropic and some existing shareholders selling stock, so the total proceeds will not all flow to the company. Cornerstone investors include TSMC (2330‑TW), Nvidia (NVDA‑US), AMD (AMD‑US), Broadcom (AVGO‑US), Micron (MU‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and Google under Alphabet (GOOGL‑US). The final issue price is still to be set, and after the IPO the shares are expected to list on Nasdaq under the ticker “ANT”.

Revenue from the Claude model drove a 47% quarter‑over‑quarter increase in Q3, reaching $16.96 billion, and net loss narrowed, though the growth rate fell short of the 144% seen in Q2. The company said the growth stems from rapid adoption of Claude, including specialized products for healthcare, finance and legal services sectors.

The revenue expansion is accompanied by massive compute spending. Anthropic’s procurement commitments for compute from partners such as Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Google approach $900 billion, and whether future capacity can be realized depends on external financing beyond the company’s control. With borrowing costs high and investors focusing more on AI returns, this listing will test the market’s assessment of Claude’s growth outlook and long‑term funding needs.
